title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): one-property twin (checksum)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the embedded checksum does not validate. Legacy mutation notes: checksum: the CRC32 computed over cflt plus the body (58 characters) instead of the documented 54 body characters; prefix, length and alphabet unchanged, checksum: the CRC32 of the 54 body characters encoded big-endian instead of the documented little-endian; prefix, length and alphabet unchanged, and checksum: the first of the six checksum characters changed, so they no longer equal the Base64 CRC32 of the 54 body characters; prefix, length and alphabet unchanged. Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of confluent-cloud-api-secret-cli-api-key-create-json: checksum: the CRC32 computed over cflt plus the body (58 characters) instead of the documented 54 body characters; prefix, length and alphabet unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
